traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast _Acid Arrow_ (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +11, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. _Failure:_ 54 (12d8) Acid damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):
 **At Will:** _Acid Arrow_ (level 3 version), _Detect Magic_, _Fear_
 **1/Day Each:** _Speak with Dead_, _Vitriolic Sphere_

legendaryActions.text: _Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns._

legendaryActions.name: Cloud of Insects
legendaryActions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 17, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. _Failure:_ 22 (4d10) Poison damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. _Failure or Success:_ The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Frightful Presence
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast _Fear_. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
